profile.name: Chetan Mulge
profile.availability: Open to software engineering and AI/ML opportunities
profile.intro: I’m a software developer and MCA graduate interested in building useful products across web development, computer vision, and AI. I enjoy moving between code, experiments, and creative digital experiences.
notes: I completed my MCA at the Central University of Karnataka in 2026, after earning my BCA from Sharnbasva University.
My technical interests include Python, C, SQL, web development, machine learning, OpenCV, and YOLO-based computer vision.
Outside software development, I enjoy video editing and exploring cinematic, interactive web experiences.
profile.deskWelcome: Welcome to my little corner of the internet. Explore the projects, open a few windows, and leave a note.
